mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong economic growth, which should positively impact corporate earnings and drive up S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDP growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative over the 20-day horizon in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market weakness, which could lead to negative S&P 500 returns as consumer spending and business investment may decline.
failure_condition: If the unemployment rate rises but S&P 500 returns remain positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When both the unemployment rate (UNRATE) increases and payroll employment (PAYEMS) decreases, it indicates a weakening labor market, which could lead to negative S&P 500 returns as economic growth falters.
failure_condition: If both UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates tighter monetary policy, which could lead to negative S&P 500 returns as borrowing costs increase and corporate profitability is squeezed.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5% but S&P 500 returns remain positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates higher inflation, which could lead to negative S&P 500 returns as the Federal Reserve may raise interest rates to combat inflation.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL exceeds 2% but S&P 500 returns remain positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong economic activity, which should positively impact corporate earnings and drive up S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If industrial production increases but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP growth (GDPC1) is strong but the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is also high, it indicates conflicting economic signals, which could lead to negative S&P 500 returns due to increased uncertainty.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth is strong and FEDFUNDS is high but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong demand in the housing market, which could lead to positive S&P 500 returns as related industries like construction and furniture benefit.
failure_condition: If housing starts increase by more than 5% but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 30% of cases.
